newsitem.title: USA: T/SF Communications gets buyout offer.
newsitem.headline: T/SF Communications gets buyout offer.

text.p: T/SF Communications Corp said Tuesday a group of senior officers and Fir Tree Partners, a group which holds 14 percent of T/SF's shares, have offered to buyout the company.

The group said it will offer $37 each for 2,050,000 T/SF shares in a tender offer to begin within four to eight weeks. The total value of the deal would be $75.9 million if the tender is fully subscribed, and would result in T/SF becoming a private company.
The tender offer will be subject to concluding negotiations for necessary financing and other conditions.
TS/F shares traded up 1/8 to 27-3/4 early Tuesday afternoon.
The company publishes trade journals and specialty publications, provides trademark research and provides pre-employment screening services and information, mainly for the trucking industry.
